chapter: Recordings as a leader and the Getz years
title: Live at Maybeck Recital Hall
summary: The hall in Dick Whittington's house looked like a cathedral.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Then the next one is near and dear to my heart, 1990, Live at Maybeck Hall, because that’s just up the street from where I live, on Concord Records. It’s a nice hall. How did that gig feel? Do you remember that one?
It felt great, yeah. That was a hell of a performance space. Dick – the guy who lived there. He played piano himself.
Dick Whittington. That was just – to have a place like that in your house to play in, wow. It looked like a cathedral, with real high ceilings. It was incredible.
